messages:
ana_release: starting canary for inference-router v2026-03-21 in changewindow (canary 12%) 1: quick obs sweep first.
deploy-bot: Canary started service=inference-router version=v2026-03-21 env=prod region=us-east-1 canary=12% (id=cb-1768123456) :rocket:
ana_release: checklist: p95, 5xx by route, 429s, kvcache miss-rate, queue depth. dashboard -> /dashboards/deploy/inference-router
ricardo_sre: pulling p95 and error-rate now. baseline p95 180ms, canary 185ms. small.
liz_ops: seeing a 502 bump +13 in last 5m for route=rerank. others look fine.
ricardo_sre: query used: `sum(increase(http_requests_total{job=\"inference-router\",code=~\"5..\"}[5m])) by (route)` 1 rerank: +13
ana_release: isolation check: host isolates show rerank errors from node rack-b-03.
ricardo_sre: logs: java.lang.NullPointerException at com.redwood.rerank.ShardLookup 1 NPE in redis client when shard metadata missing.
liz_ops: how long to hotfix? estimate ~45m including QA.
ana_release: threshold for pause: error delta > 20 or p95 > 40% or 429s > 50. current error delta 13 < 20. propose partial pin of rerank-route to v2026-03-20 for canary traffic only.
ricardo_sre: agree partial pin is low-risk. will keep host rack-b-03 on watch.
liz_ops: executing pin: `tools/routerctl pin rerank --from v2026-03-21 --to v2026-03-20 --percent 100 --scope=canary`
patchbot: Route pin applied: rerank -> v2026-03-20 for canary (id=cb-1768123456) :white_check_mark:
liz_ops: rerank 5xx back to baseline within 90s. p95 unchanged. good.
ricardo_sre: collecting traces from rack-b-03 and capturing logs to /runs/1768123456/traces.tar.gz for postmortem.
nana_release: decision: continue rollout to 40% now, note partial pin in release notes, follow up with post-deploy issue to fix shard metadata handling.
liz_ops: updated release_notes: "Partial route pin: rerank -> v2026-03-20 during canary due to transient NPE in shard lookup; no full rollback. Follow-up: fix missing shard metadata handling (ticket INF-4312)."
nana_release: ops, please increase to 40% and we'll monitor 10m.
deploy-bot: Canary percent increased to 40% by liz_ops at 1768123500.
liz_ops: will bump to 80% in 10m if no regressions.
ricardo_sre: saving metrics snapshot and alert history to /runs/1768123456/obs_snapshot.json.
nana_release: thanks all. leaving thread open for any late signals.
